items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Cicely Tyson, here recently, was a great television show about the saga of a life of Miss Jane Pittman. Was on television. [INTERVIEWEE] Oh, oh, Jane Pittman. Jane Pittman.

ctx.x: Would you think that that would have anything to do then with the television show last season, Cicely Tyson, here recently, was a great television show about the saga of a life of Miss Jane Pittman. Was on television.
Oh, oh, Jane Pittman. Jane Pittman.
I wonder if it had any connection with this Pittman. [Film based on The Autobiography of Miss Jane Pittman, a novel by Ernest Gaines.]
